name: ServiceRegistryQuery
title: ServiceRegistryQuery - Global
summary: The ServiceRegistryQuery script include provides methods to map Shazzam service registry query results against a port probe. Child classes provide specifics on mapping.
overview: Use this script include during the discovery scanning phase.
